title: The Fourth Book
author: Alexis of Piemont
full_title: The Secretes of the Reuerende Maister Alexis of Piemount
summary: Cosmetics: waters to whiten and colour the face and take away spots and sunburn, rouges, dyes to make the hair golden or black, ointments to make hair fall off, and powders and conserves to whiten the teeth and fasten the gums.
